weather.conditions: Widespread Showers And Thunderstorms then Chance T-storms
weather.text: Scattered rain showers before 8pm, then widespread showers and thunderstorms between 8pm and midnight, then a chance of thunderstorms and widespread rain and snow showers between midnight and 5am. Cloudy. Low around 32, with temperatures rising to around 36 overnight. Southwest wind 12 to 24 mph, with gusts as high as 37 mph. Chance of precipitation is 100%. New snow accumulation of 1 to 2 inches possible.
